scenes.text: An even number can be put into pairs without leftovers; an odd number leaves one when arranged in pairs.
Is 80 even or odd? The answer is even. 80 can be split into equal groups of two.
A bag at a school fair contains 49 marbles. Could they be paired without a leftover? Choose the number type. Pause the video and think.
A bag at a school fair contains 49 marbles. Could they be paired without a leftover? Choose the number type. The answer is odd. 49 cannot be split into equal groups of two.
